question: In which state was the special awareness campaign for women ‘Mission Shakti’ launched in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Shakti** was launched in Uttar Pradesh in October 2020.

 
 
• ​It is an integrated **women empowerment programme**.
 
• It deals with the **safety, security and empowerment of women**.
 
• Its duration is for five years from **2021-22 to 2025-2026**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Important Schemes **
 **States**
 
 

 National Family Benefit Scheme, Old Age Pension Scheme and Mukhya Mantri Samuhik Vivah Yojna
 Uttar Pradesh
 
 

 CM Aarthik Kalyan Yojna, Janani Suraksha Yojana and Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme.
 Madhya Pradesh
 
 

 Mukhyamantri Harit Krishi Sanyantra Yojana, Bihar Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Civil Seva Protsahan Yojana.
 Bihar
 
 

 Public Provident Fund (PPF), Senior Citizen Saving Scheme andSukanaya Samriddhi Scheme.
